subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should Feishu outbound hook parity be fixed first while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening is tracked separately?
rationale: The outbound gap is a documented hook-coverage bug, but broadening `inbound_claim` changes plugin claim authority and ordering before agent routing.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix the Feishu/shared dispatcher outbound `message_sending` gap first and open or use a separate tracker for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

options.title: Fold into the broader hook bypass track
options.body: Move the Feishu evidence under the existing outbound-hook canonical issue and leave this issue mainly for the inbound-claim API discussion.

options.title: Solve every requested hook together
options.body: Use one broader design PR for outbound parity and normal inbound claiming, accepting higher compatibility and security review cost.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix the Feishu/shared dispatcher outbound `message_sending` gap first and open or use a separate tracker for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved human choice includes `inbound_claim` and plugin-owned binding semantics tied to their plugin-surface history.
